EventEdits.description:
Changes a student makes to a proposed event before approving it. Only what was sent is
changed; `start_time` of "" turns a timed event into an all-day one.
EventEdits.title: EventEdits

MaterialPatch.description: Fields a student may change on a file. `module` set to null or an empty string clears it.
MaterialPatch.title: MaterialPatch

MeUpdate.description:
Only the fields that are present are changed. answer_language may be null, which means
"reply in the language of the question".
MeUpdate.title: MeUpdate

Overview.description: The figures of whatever the dashboard is scoped to (one course, or every course).
Overview.title: Overview

RubricIn.description: An empty list removes the rubric.
RubricIn.title: RubricIn

SecurityOut.description: What the Security tab needs to decide which options to show.
SecurityOut.title: SecurityOut

StartIn.description: Optional settings when an attempt is started; absent means the quiz's own default limit.
StartIn.title: StartIn

SubjectUpdate.description: Only fields that are present change. Send null (or blank) to clear an optional field.
SubjectUpdate.title: SubjectUpdate

post.description:
Upload a file (the question paper, a handout, a marking guide) onto this assignment. It is
stored in the assignment's course like any other upload and read in the background.

delete.description: Take a file off the assignment. The file itself is deleted too: it was uploaded for this.

post.description: Pin the draft as it is saved now, with an optional note ("first full draft").

Make an older snapshot the draft again. What the draft was is kept first, so a restore
can always be undone.

get.description:
Every piece of AI help on this assignment, newest first (the detail page only carries the
latest of each kind).

schema.title: Response List Runs Api V1 Assignments  Assignment Id  Runs Get

post.description: A new revision quiz from the questions this attempt got wrong (or only partly right).
Always answers the same way, so it cannot be used to discover which emails have accounts.
Public on purpose: signing out must work even when the session already expired.

get.description: Tells the sign-in page whether to show the Google button.

post.description: Public so the link works from any browser, including one that is not signed in.

get.description:
The student's chats, newest first. With `q`, only chats whose title or messages contain it
(plain text, case does not matter), each with a short piece of the text that matched.

schema.title: Response List Conversations Api V1 Conversations Get
Response List Attachments Api V1 Conversations  Conversation Id  Attachments Get

post.description:
Attach a PDF, Word file or picture of text to this conversation. Its text is read in the
background; the answers of this conversation can then use it.

The student's answer to a proposal the chat paused on (approve, edit-and-approve, cancel).

The run continues from where it paused and its answer is added to the message that holds the
proposal card. Only the newest run of the conversation can be answered, once, and only while
it is still fresh; anything else is 409 `approval_expired`.

patch.description: Choose what this conversation may search: every course, one course, or chosen files.

get.description: Every course with its figures, newest activity first. Same filters as GET /subjects.

schema.title: Response List Datasets Api V1 Eval Datasets Get

patch.description: Hand-edit one question. The merged result is validated like an imported line.

get.description:
Is each evidence phrase actually present in the student's processed materials?

Run this after uploading the corpus: a phrase that is not found can never be retrieved, so
it would only drag the scores down for a reason that has nothing to do with search quality.

schema.title: Response List Items Api V1 Groups  Group Id  Items Get

post.description: Copy a shared file into one of the student's own subjects. It is then read like any upload.
An owner or admin decides a hidden file is fine: it shows again and the reports are cleared.

delete.description: An owner removes admins and members; an admin removes members. Their files go with them.

patch.description: The owner makes a member an admin, or an admin an ordinary member again.

Response List Sessions Api V1 Groups  Group Id  Sessions Get

schema.title: Response List Threads Api V1 Groups  Group Id  Threads Get

get.description: Liveness: the process is up. Does not touch any dependency.

post.description:
Send again what failed last time. An item that no longer needs sending (the student deleted
it, or it already matches Google) just loses its failure.

get.description: What is on Google, what is waiting to be sent and what failed (with why).

post.description: Copy one of the student's materials into the library with the audience they choose.

get.description: The values students can filter a tab by: only what is actually in that tab.
Suggestions while typing an institution name (only names that two or more students use).

schema.title: Response Institutions Api V1 Library Institutions Get

delete.description: Withdraw a file. Copies other students already added to their courses stay with them.

patch.description: Edit the description or change the audience. Public items go back to review after any edit.

post.description: Copy a library file into one of the student's own subjects, where it is read like any upload.

get.description:
The file itself. `inline` shows PDFs, images and text in the browser (a preview); anything
else is always a download.

post.description: The student looked at this file (or inspected a chat source from it).

get.description:
A JSON copy of the user's own profile, courses and file list.

File contents, chat history and provider keys are not included: files stay downloadable from
the library, and keys are write-only by design.

post.description: Change the password and sign out every other device, keeping this one signed in.

put.description: Thumbs up or down on an answer (changing your mind replaces it). Only answers can be rated.

get.description: The answers this answer replaced (newest first), when the student asked for it again.

get.description:
How the course is going: quiz scores over time, accuracy by question type, weekly practice,
how much of the course has been read and tried, assignments, cards due, and what to do next.
The assignments of this course: open ones first, by due date.

schema.title: Response Course Assignments Api V1 Subjects  Subject Id  Assignments Get

get.description: What deleting would remove, so the dialog can show it before the user confirms.

schema.title: Response List Materials Api V1 Subjects  Subject Id  Materials Get

post.description:
Rename a module (every file labelled with it), merge it into another, or empty it
(`new` blank: the files stay but belong to no module). With `old` null, the files that are in
no module are put into `new`. Names that differ only in case or spacing are the same module.

get.description: The figures for one course plus its upcoming exams: what the workspace header shows.

Accuracy per source document and per module, from the marked quiz answers of this course.

A document counts as weak under the same rule as the dashboard (fewer than 80% over at least
three answers). Documents never practised are listed with zero answers so the student can see
what has not been tried yet.
